description: Use this for any question about building credit as an immigrant, newcomer, international student, or temporary resident in Canada. Returns the ordered path for someone new to Canada: what to do before a SIN arrives, whether their home-country history can be imported and at which banks, how to get a first tradeline, and what accumulates after that. Supply the home country for a specific answer on credit import; coverage is partial, and several of the largest source countries for Canadian newcomers are not covered at all. Returns bundled reference material, optionally filtered or calculated from inputs; does not fetch live data or change accounts.

homeCountry.description: Country the person is arriving from, in English. Determines whether the credit-import route is open.

monthsInCanada.description: Roughly how long they have been in Canada, to focus the answer on the relevant phase.

name: get_newcomer_credit_path
title: Building a Canadian credit file from zero
